P1: 6号道路 consists of a road running between 枯叶市 and 金黄市. The southern end of the Underground Path is located here, but according to a man standing nearby, is closed until some problem at the 无人发电厂 is resolved.
P2: 金黄市 is a sprawling metropolis located in the heart of the region between 华蓝市, 玉虹市, 紫苑镇, and 枯叶市. The Silph Co. headquarters dominates the city skyline, two Pokémon Gyms stand in the northeast district, and the Magnet Train station is located in the northwest. It is the most populous city in all of Kanto.
M1: The same as the traded Pokémon
M2: 1 只（Pikachu is of a different language origin）
D2: Southeast house; from Mr. Psychic in his home
D3: Silph Co.; from the security guard on 1F
D4: Silph Co.; held by Iron, a 铁哑铃 received through a trade
D5: Held by Voltsy, a 皮卡丘 received through a trade

P3: The southeast house belongs to a man known as Mr. Psychic. Speak to him, and after a moment of meditation, he hands out 招式学习器29（精神强念）.
P4: Silph Co. is open to the public, but a security guard explains that the elevator is not working due to some problem at the Power Plant. He feels bad that you wasted a visit, and gives out an Up-Grade, one of the company's newest products that has not yet been released, as a souvenir.
P5: The Magnet Train station is located in the northwest part of the city. The train uses electricity and magnets to reach incredible speeds, but is also not running at the moment because of a service interruption at the Power Plant.
P6: 金黄市 is unique as the only city to have two Pokémon Gyms. The Fighting Dojo is located in the northeast neighborhood, next door to the Saffron Gym. The two clubs had once competed to determine which would become the city's one official Gym, and the 超能力 Pokémon of Saffron Gym were victorious. A Black Belt informs visitors that the dojo's leader, the Karate King, is in a cave in Johto for training.
P7: Having proven your worth by reaching the Hall of Fame, you may now begin meeting with each Gym Leader in order to register his or her phone number in the Pokégear. Most numbers can only be obtained on a certain day and/or at a certain time, and some have additional requirements.
C8: * Defeat Janine and obtain the 粉红徽章
C29: * Team up with 劲敌（西尔弗） to defeat her and Lance in a Multi Battle
C40: * Talk to him while walking with a 皮卡丘
C66: * Have Daisy groom Pokémon at least seven times * Show Daisy a Pokémon with maximum friendship
P8: After a Gym Leader's phone number is obtained, he or she will only agree to a rematch if called during a certain period. He or she will then travel to the Fighting Dojo to wait for the battle, and will remain here until defeated. Each Gym Leader may be rebattled multiple times this way.

The Master of Psychic Pokémon
P10: The Saffron Gym specializes in 超能力 Pokémon. Psychic-type moves are super effective against 格斗- and 毒 Pokémon, while Psychic-type Pokémon are weak to 虫-, 恶-, and 幽灵 moves.
P11: The Gym uses a series of warp tiles to confuse and disorient any challengers. Step on the tile near the entrance to reach the southeast room. To reach the Gym Leader by using as few warps as possible, continue by stepping on the northwest, southwest, and southwest tiles in the following rooms. This leads to the center room, where the Gym Leader awaits anyone up to the challenge.
P12: Although Sabrina has only three Pokémon, they can become difficult to defeat if given the chance. She leads with her 太阳伊布; both 精神强念 and 暗影球 may lower the target's 特防, letting it deal even more damage with subsequent attacks. 冥想 boosts its 特攻 and Special Defense, further increasing its damage output. 魔墙人偶's 模仿 copies the target's most recent move, and 特性互换 lets it trade Abilities with the target. As Filter reduces damage sustained from super effective moves, using Skill Swap may actually backfire as it loses this protection. Her 胡地 cannot boost its power like Espeon can, but its high Special Attack makes it unnecessary. Both Psychic and 能量球 may lower the target's Special Defense, and 反射壁 temporarily raises the team's physical 防御, a common weakness of Psychic Pokémon.
P13: After the battle, Sabrina awards you the 金色徽章. She also gives out 招式学习器48（特性互换） as a prize.
P14: To reach the exit, simply step on the red warp tile nearby.
